_readme: Contact details printed on the flyer and the one-pager.
Both are blank because there is no business phone number or contact email
anywhere in this codebase, and inventing one on a piece handed to hospitals
and colleges is not a guess worth making.
Fill in phone and email, then rebuild:
make_print.py prints a warning naming whichever of these is still empty, so
a blank cannot reach a printer without somebody having been told twice.
